bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to public safety; appropriating money for an extreme risk protection orders public awareness campaign.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. PUBLIC AWARENESS CAMPAIGN; EXTREME RISK PROTECTION ORDERS.

$....... in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of public safety for a public awareness campaign to increase awareness of and educate the public and law enforcement about extreme risk protection orders. The commissioner may contract with a private entity for the public awareness campaign.

EFFECTIVE DATE.

This section is effective the day following final enactment.
